decisions: Keep base reference decisions. Display their mapped probability cutoff; probability previews are separate and may differ at isotonic ties.
evaluation: Reused native final/diagnostic views, older online cohorts and authored scenarios; not fitting or selection. No new independent real-world validation.
fit_data: Existing IBM calibration cohorts outside base fitting rows. Card:2019Q3 bucket4; online and reviewer:2016Q4 bucket3 plus2019Q3 bucket4. Both history views.
goal: Train probability output models, not remap a threshold to 50.
limitations: Development cohorts previously used for base threshold/architecture selection. Grouped CV evaluates new probability heads only, not the full historical selection process. Limited fraud support and source shift remain.
methods: sigmoid: logistic regression C1 no class reweighting
selection: Lowest pooled out-of-fold log loss; Brier tie-break. Refit selected mapping on full development cohort once; freeze before diagnostic evaluation.
validation: Four deterministic customer-grouped folds (SHA256 probability-v1:user mod4), all views of a source row in the same fold. No outcome-based split selection.
weights: Each source transaction has total weight1 across views. No fraud oversampling or class costs in probability fitting.
